about: Spell golf's one hole (docs/BACKLOG.md 24; World.Golf.cs): the tee and the hole as grid cells (y grows south), on the open meadow north of the defense field, 60 cells (90 m) apart over a low rise. Clear of the yard, Hollowmere, the cabins, the tower, the court and the defense field; nothing in things.json stands between them.
